text_block_list.text:
Early in the morning, on the deserted 
grounds, Mejiro McQueen was there.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps today... I should focus primarily 
on improving my form.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Hmm, this doesn't feel quite 
right...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
We still have time, so... Alright, just a 
little more...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... *haa*... I-I never intended... to 
run this much...

Mejiro McQueen pushed herself too hard 
during morning training and ended up 
completely exhausted.
